Required Fields on a New Employee

User manual · English · 5 steps
Learn what happens when you save a new employee without the required fields, and how to read Odoo's message.

1. Open Employees

Open the Employees app.

2. New

Click New to start an employee.

3. Save

Click the save icon without filling anything in.

4. Read the message

Read the red message. Click it to continue.

5. Discard

Click the discard icon to leave without saving.
